about.html:
About the calculations

The astrological hour on the Now tab is counted from sunrise: number = floor(minutes since sunrise / 24) + 1, from 1 to 60.

Hourly alternation is a textual norm; the real nasal cycle is usually 1.5–3 hours and irregular. Tibetan lunar day numbers may differ by one.

This channel-watching tool is inspired by Kalachakra astrology, which suggests acting in accord with the active channel to transform karma on the path to enlightenment for the benefit of all beings. The follows notes from Alexander Hosmo’s seminars.

Time in Kalachakra

In the absolute all three times are present. Sacred time is always within us; the time of the material world begins when the mind separates itself from the one — a thought appears.

Breath is tied to thought, so time is measured in breaths: 21,600 thoughts a day are named for a healthy middle-aged person.

Channel activity

According to the “Shiva Swarodaya” (Sanskrit and translation by Ram Kumar Rai, Varanasi), the channel at sunrise is set by the lunar day (tithi) in force at sunrise: tithi = floor((Moon longitude − Sun longitude) / 12°) + 1. Days 1–3, 7–9, 13–15 of the waxing Moon start with the lunar channel, 4–6 and 10–12 with the solar; the waning Moon is the reverse. The channel then changes every 60 minutes until the next sunrise, where it is taken anew. The last stretch before sunrise is usually short and is shown as is.

Chinese hours

Twelve double hours on true solar time (the Sun's hour angle), starting with 子 at 23:00. Day pillar: (Julian day + 49) mod 60. The hour spirit (yellow and black path) follows the day branch; an hour clashing with the day is unfavourable.
